   - **Prisma v6**: Shop-scoped queries mandatory — `where: { shop: session.shop }`
   - **Law 1**: `authenticate.admin(request)` first in every loader/action
   - **Law 6**: Every `JSON.parse` wrapped in try/catch with fallback
   - **Law 12**: Every action wrapped in try/catch returning `json({ error })`

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:dev.sqlite"
}

model Session {
  id                  String    @id
  shop                String
  state               String
  isOnline            Boolean   @default(false)
  scope               String?
  expires             DateTime?
  accessToken         String
  userId              BigInt?
  firstName           String?
  lastName            String?
  email               String?
  accountOwner        Boolean   @default(false)
  locale              String?
  collaborator        Boolean?  @default(false)
  emailVerified       Boolean?  @default(false)
  refreshToken        String?
  refreshTokenExpires DateTime?
}

model Shop {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shopDomain String  @unique
  plan       String  @default("free") // free, starter, pro
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  quizzes   Quiz[]
  settings  ShopSettings?
}

model ShopSettings {
  id                    String  @id @default(cuid())
  shopId                String  @unique
  shop                  Shop    @relation(fields: [shopId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // General
  defaultLanguage       String  @default("English")
  showBranding          Boolean @default(true)
  revenueAttributionWindow Int  @default(7) // days
  customerTagPrefix     String  @default("qs-")

  // Email Capture
  collectEmails         Boolean @default(true)
  emailHeadline         String  @default("Almost there! Get your personalised results")
  gdprConsentText       String  @default("I agree to receive personalised recommendations by email.")
  skipLinkText          String  @default("Skip — show results anyway")
  discountCode          String  @default("")

  // Integrations
  klaviyoConnected      Boolean @default(false)
  klaviyoApiKey         String  @default("")
  omnisendConnected     Boolean @default(false)
  omnisendApiKey        String  @default("")
  shopifyFlowConnected  Boolean @default(false)
  webhookUrl            String  @default("")
  webhookConnected      Boolean @default(false)

  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Quiz {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shopId      String
  shop        Shop     @relation(fields: [shopId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  title       String
  description String   @default("")
  status      String   @default("draft") // draft, live, archived
  template    String   @default("blank") // skincare, supplement, style, haircare, fitness, blank
  emoji       String   @default("📝")

  // Email capture per-quiz override
  allowSkipEmail Boolean @default(true)

  // Stats (denormalized for performance)
  completions    Int    @default(0)
  conversions    Int    @default(0)
  revenue        Float  @default(0)
  emailsCaptured Int    @default(0)

  questions   Question[]
  sessions    QuizSession[]

  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Question {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  quizId      String
  quiz        Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  title       String
  description String   @default("")
  type        String   @default("single_choice") // single_choice, multiple_choice, image_choice, dropdown, slider, yes_no, email_capture
  required    Boolean  @default(true)
  order       Int      @default(0)

  // Slider-specific
  sliderMin   Int?
  sliderMax   Int?
  sliderStep  Int?
  sliderUnit  String?

  answers     Answer[]

  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Answer {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  questionId  String
  question    Question @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  label       String
  imageUrl    String   @default("")
  order       Int      @default(0)

  // Product mapping
  productMappings AnswerProductMapping[]

  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model AnswerProductMapping {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  answerId    String
  answer      Answer   @relation(fields: [answerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  shopifyProductId    String
  shopifyProductTitle String  @default("")
  shopifyProductImage String  @default("")
  weight              Int     @default(1) // recommendation weight

  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model QuizSession {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  quizId      String
  quiz        Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  shopperEmail    String?
  status          String  @default("started") // started, completed, abandoned
  completedAt     DateTime?
  purchasedAt     DateTime?
  purchaseAmount  Float?
  shopifyOrderId  String?

  responses   QuizResponse[]

  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model QuizResponse {
  id          String      @id @default(cuid())
  sessionId   String
  session     QuizSession @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  questionId  String
  answerIds   String      @default("") // comma-separated answer IDs for multi-select
  sliderValue Int?
  textValue   String?

  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
}
